title: Primary Palette
slide_intent: Repeat colors that carry recognition because a stable core helps people identify the brand across changing applications.
strategic_value: Fiery Red, Flaming Orange and BBQ Brown can preserve Burger King equity and its flame-grilling association.
demonstration: Three full-height fields show red, orange and brown with production values; text on red explains their required presence and a plant-based exception.
practical_value: Include at least one primary color in a branded application, preserving the stated occasional exception for plant-based products.

content_islands.name: Primary-color rationale
content_islands.spec: Place the flame-grilling and brand-equity explanation in the upper red field.

content_islands.name: Three primary swatches
content_islands.spec: Use broad red, orange and brown columns with named Pantone, HEX, RGB and CMYK definitions near the bottom.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says the primary palette is inspired by flame grilling and holds brand equity and differentiation.
reference_purposes.Expression: The three large warm color fields demonstrate the core palette.
reference_purposes.Application: Each primary hue includes production specifications.
reference_purposes.Constraint: At least one primary color appears in a branded application; plant-based products can sometimes be an exception.

ingredient.name: Primary palette
ingredient.role: Carry recognition and the flame-grilling association.
ingredient.application: Include at least one of Fiery Red, Flaming Orange or BBQ Brown in each branded application.
ingredient.scope: Historical guide; plant-based products can sometimes be excepted. Printed Fiery Red HEX #D62300 and RGB R215 G35 B0 differ by one red-channel unit.
